item.title: AMD and Secihti team on Mexico AI talent push
item.summary: Mexico’s Ministry of Science, Humanities, Technology and Innovation (Secihti) has signed a memorandum of understanding with AMD to expand the country’s capabilities in artificial intelligence, high-performance computing (HPC) and semiconductor technologies. The collaboration will focus on developing specialized talent, scientific research and the infrastructure needed to support a broader national technology ecosystem.
